STH1G SERIES SWITCHES
DATASHEET
High Performance Enterprise and Campus Network Switch
Version: V1.3
Release Date: 2025/12/25
Product Overview
The STH1G Series switches are designed
on a domestic new generation switch
Chip, which is called VastLakes Series
Chip platform .
With 48 x 1G or 24 x 1G high speed
ports and rich features, these switches
will perfectly meets the requirements of
Metro, Enterprise and campus networks.
Key features of the STH1G Series Switches
l Support MPLS Features
l Varied port types support 100M/1G/25G/40G ports to meet different network requirement
l Implementing Vxlan and BGP protocols to build EVPN applications for Enterprise and
Campus scenario.
l Switch-to-switch encryption using MACsec (Media Access Control Security) AES-CMAC.
l Precision Timing Protocol.
l Rich L2/L3 features like IPv6, OSPF, BGP, PIM, etc.
The STH1G Series switches provide various power supply solutions for customers choosing,
fixed single power supply, fixed redundant power supplies, and redundant hot-swappable
power supplies (AC and DC are both available).
The Fan solutions also have two bays with
Field replaceable fan modules and build in fans.
Generally, air flow of STH1G Series is front
to rear (AFO), and some of models can do customization of rear to front (AFI) airflow.

The STH1G Series switches support varied management ways, include console port / in-band
network ports / out-of-band network port. Support SNMP v1/v2/v3, Support CLI (Command Line
Interface), web management, Telnet and FTP connection. Support OAM to make management more
convenient, and support SSH2.0, SSL, etc. to ensure security of management.
Moreover, leveraging its profound technical expertise and in-depth understanding of campus and
enterprise networking needs, Saga Telecom has launched the Da Hu Cloud Management System
(DHCS).
It enhances network management and maintenance efficiency, reduces costs, elevates management
intelligence, and delivers a faster, smarter, more secure and reliable network to better meet user
requirements.
